t: A question he asked instead of a statement
a: أَرَأَيْتُمْ لَوْ أَنَّ نَهَرًا بِبَابِ أَحَدِكُمْ، يَغْتَسِلُ فِيهِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ خَمْسًا، مَا تَقُولُ ذَلِكَ يُبْقِي مِنْ دَرَنِهِ
p: A-raʾaytum law anna naharan bi-bābi aḥadikum yaghtasilu fīhi kulla yawmin khamsan, mā taqūlu dhālika yubqī min daranih
m: Tell me, if there were a river at the door of one of you and he washed in it five times a day, would that leave any of his dirt behind?
